title: The Shape Museum: Vault of Five Doors
visibleText:
NIGHT
INSPECTOR
The Shape Museum

The Shape Museum needs a Night Inspector. Five vault doors are sealed.
Only your five inspection reports can open them. Nobody has seen what's inside.

The museum files reports without judging them — the archive is opened later. Every filed report turns a lock, so all five doors open no matter what you write. If you are not sure about an exhibit, you may file it as Unresolved. That is normal inspector work.

START INSPECTION
